parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can obtain this value by calling the ListApplications operation.

parameters.name: RescaleLevel
parameters.description:
The level of the scaling region. Valid values:

- AreaIspCode: region ISP.
- RegionId: edge zone.
- InstanceId: instance. Scale-out indicates resource hosting. Scale-in indicates resource release.

Default value: AreaIspCode.

parameters.name: RescaleType
parameters.description:
The scaling action for resources. Valid values:
- Add: Provisions new resources.
- Del: Releases resources.

parameters.name: ResourceSelector
parameters.description: The scaling resource requirements. The value is a string in JSON array format.

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The timeout period for asynchronous scaling, in seconds. Default value: 300.

parameters.name: ToAppVersion
parameters.description: The application deployment version for new resources. This parameter takes effect only when resources are added. Default value: the stable version number of the application.
